Two people were sitting together at dinner talking about the diets they had just recently started as part of their new year's resolution this year, one slim and the other fat. The slim friend was optimistic about continuing the diet, as it had been going pretty well so far, but the fat person wasn't optimistic at all, as they had already already broken the diet half a dozen times and it wasn't even March yet. Who is successful at dieting?
A. The fat friend
B. Can't be determined
C. The slim friend
